quest.title: Treasure Lost, Treasure Found
quest.description: What secret does this set of archaic admonishments hold?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Liyue Shrine of Depths Key x1

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Guizhong's Four Commandments... What are they really trying to tell us...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Haha, raring to go! That's what I like to see. Then let's begin our reading of Guizhong's Four Commandments.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: "Teach with wisdom, be bound by virtue, fortify the bones, unite in ambition — the convergence of these four shall be known as the 'Guili Assembly.'"

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: On the surface, it does read like a set of commandments. Golden rules for life.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: But it's also supposed to contain some sort of clues to a hidden treasure...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: ...I can't decipher it, though. It seems we'll have to approach this in what academics like to call the old-fashioned way...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Those seven passages we found previously, they were all located in ruins of some sort.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Since we're not sure where to start this time, perhaps keep searching in ruins for now.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Hmm... For now, let's limit the search area to Guili Plains.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: However... as I'm just a scholar, there's no way I'd be able to keep up with you out in the field.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: So I will leave the actual ruin-searching to you. Just let me know what you find.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: While we're on the subject — I once came across a strange plate with some writing on in one of the ruins around here.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: I only looked at it in isolation though. Didn't do any sort of holistic analysis.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Now I think about it, it might be connected to Guizhong's Four Commandments.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: How about I mark the location on your map? You should go check it out, maybe it'll lead somewhere.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Obviously not... We'd never be able to cover all the ruins in Liyue just between the two of us.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: So let's limit the search area. Since the treasure has to do with the Guili Assembly from the Guili Plains...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: ...Let's restrict our search to the Guili Plains area for now.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Oh, and one other thing. There's no way a scholar like me could keep up with you out in the field.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: So I will leave the actual ruin-searching to you. Just let me know what you find.

choices.text: Ruins of Liyue, here I come!

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Wait! Hold on a second! ...How exactly do you propose to cover every single ruin in Liyue!? It'll take you forever!

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: You can't afford to get so excited every time you hear the word treasure, you know.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: How about this — since we know the treasure comes from the Guili Assembly in the Guili Plains, let's restrict the search area.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Okay... to start with, let's limit the search to inside Guili Plains...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Hold on! I'm not finished yet! ...Don't forget to search the ruins thoroughly. And if you find anything of interest, come back and let me know.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Remember, stick to the Guili Plains! Don't let your boundless enthusiasm lead you further afield.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Whew, the slightest mention of treasure and you're suddenly beside yourself with excitement... Hmm, so be it — let's begin our reading of Guizhong's Four Commandments.

talks.objective: Ask Soraya about the saying of the nearby area

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm definitely intrigued.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: I'll mark the first ruins I found on your map. I'd suggest starting there.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If you do find something, don't make the amateur mistake of running off in your excitement. Be sure to <color=#00E1FFFF>note down the clue</color> first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's some writing on this plate! ...But it's barely readable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like it might have some special meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: I wonder how the Guili Assembly met its demise...

talks.objective: Enter the ruin and search for a strange jade plate
Enter the ruin and search for a strange jade plate
Enter the ruin and search for a strange jade plate
Enter the ruin and search for a strange jade plate

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Sometimes fate is inescapable, even for a god...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found four clues in four ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Four ruins, four clues... And there are Four Commandments.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Each of these clues expounds upon the meaning of one of the Four Commandments.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: To get to the correct interpretation, the original text of Guizhong's Four Commandments is key. These four are helpful, but peripheral to our enquiry.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: These five passages are all linked — but how?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Convergence..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Could "convergence" mean that... these four things all link up in some way?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Wait — I remember, each of Guizhong's Four Commandments can be found in a specific ruin...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Hmm... I am speculating here, but perhaps the four <color=#00E1FFFF>ruins</color> are relevant to deciphering the true meaning of Guizhong's Four Commandments...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: How exactly, I don't know. I need to mull it over. Maybe you could have a think too — or better still, go and investigate it firsthand.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: I'm just a skinny little scholar after all, I tire out completely after a few seconds on the run... Wish I had your stamina!

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm going to keep thinking about it for a while. If you think of anything, or if you find anything, you know where I am.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It's a speculative hypothesis, but I believe the four ruins corresponding to each of Guizhong's Four Commandments may be relevant to deciphering their true meaning...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Exactly what role the ruins are supposed to play, well, that's another question. And... I don't think I have the physical strength to test out each of my hypotheses in full...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It's also possible that I just have a one-track mind, and this idea is leading me nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Did you find the treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Did you find the treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: How is the search going? Found the treasure yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, it was about where they "converge" after all.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Really... So it's just like Guizhong's Four Commandments says. The treasure was located at "the convergence of these four..."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Whoever designed this riddle must have truly revered Guizhong.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: So much so that they preserved Guizhong's Four Commandments for future generations, even though the Guili Assembly was wiped out.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: And as for Guizhong herself, who established the commandments — she must have been adored by her people.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Clearly, she wished for her people to be wise, to hold themselves to a moral code, to be strong and healthy, and to find solidarity in the shared enterprise of protecting their home — the Guili Assembly...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Failed? I suppose you're right, she died in the end... and when the Guili Assembly was wiped out, her people no longer had a place to call home.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: And yet, today, Guizhong's Four Commandments have seen the light of day once more.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: These were the words penned by Guizhong herself to serve both as maxims and blessing for her people.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Once there was a time when she led her people to go forth and take this very land, guided by these commandments.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: She may no longer be with us, but her beliefs, the things she stood for — they will endure.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Whoever it was that revered her so much was very clever indeed. They used the allure of hidden treasure to ensure Guizhong's Four Commandments would be passed down.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Though for that person, I wonder whether the treasure they held dear was the rare metals and precious stones, or Guizhong's Four Commandments themselves.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Haha, well, to me at least, it's clear that the commandments are the real treasures here. A chest full of gold or gems can't compare.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: ...But if you made people choose, how many would really pick a list of commandments over material wealth?

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: I'm not sure "gentle-natured" is a particularly common trait of gods...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: But maybe it was once. Maybe a long, long time ago, among the gods who led the peoples of the world, there were those gentle by nature.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Those who protected their people... walked among them... stood by them as they went forth into the world...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: ...But it was the gentle gods who were ultimately powerless to protect their people. Look at Guizhong — it took an elaborate treasure hunt just to preserve the four commandments that once were the lifeblood of a whole civilization.

choices.text: I wish I could meet her...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: You want to meet a god? You do entertain some wild thoughts.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: But I'm curious, what would you say to Guizhong if you actually got to meet her?

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: "...Cheer up, Guizhong, you did your best"?

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: If it were me... I'd recite Guizhong's Four Commandments flawlessly from memory.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: And I'd tell her that her vision and her ideals were alive and well, that the people of this land still remember the things she taught to their ancestors.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: I think that for someone like Guizhong, who lost everything... That would be the only thing that could lift her spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're gonna get going.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Heading off? Well remember, if you come across anything exciting, don't forget to come back and tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Just what exactly is being hidden in this saying...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the saying...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Though we call it a saying, it's really more of a riddle.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: A riddle that has been kept alive by word of mouth among the residents of Guili Plains.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: "At the place where wisdom and ambition, unity and fortitude converge like water; that is where I shall reveal the bountiful treasures of the earth."

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: How about that, eh? However you interpret it, it sure sounds like there's some kind of buried treasure in the Guili Plains area.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If I surmise correctly, those four words should correspond to four different ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If one were to find all four ruins, perhaps they would be able to find the meaning behind this saying.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But I'm not cut out for finding all of them myself. Just finding that first one really took it out of me. Took days to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If you're interested, perhaps you could take a look. Who knows, perhaps you'll find the next lead before I do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Remind me of Guizhong's Four Commandments.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Having trouble memorizing them? I understand, most people would. Fortunately, I have a rather good memory for this sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Guizhong's Four Commandments are as follows: "Teach with wisdom, be bound by virtue, fortify the bones, unite in ambition — the convergence of these four shall be known as the 'Guili Assembly.'"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A battle for territory between the gods?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: A territorial challenge, you say? Hmm... but the Guili Assembly is said to have existed peacefully under Guizhong's rule for a very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Not that Guizhong was a particularly powerful god... At least, that's my impression...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But there seems to have been another god with the Guili Assembly besides Guizhong. I highly doubt anyone would have been foolish enough to try and take on two gods at once...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone wanted the treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Unlikely. The great gods would not have waged an all-out war over a bit of treasure that took their fancy.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Or if they did, then you have to ask yourself... What kind of treasure would it take to drive the gods into war with each other?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...Haha, I for one cannot imagine such a treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe Guizhong and one of the other gods...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Wh—What are you suggesting? ...You shouldn't pay any heed to those tall tales you hear in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Guizhong was a god, a deity... Not a mere mortal...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...S—Surely a god wouldn't... Surely not...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I also wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Maybe it's to do with the Archon War.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: A protracted war erupted between the gods, each of whom coveted a seat at one of the seven divine thrones in Celestia.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It seems that none in Teyvat escaped the reach of that all-consuming war.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Don't forget to come back and tell me if you find anything.
